task.description:
Summary of the independent readers of the Kazakh and English texts of REQ-070 (WF-02 step 8, criterion 5 of REQ-070; you are BA-ANALYST in the role of the one who sums up; you do NOT translate and do NOT write code). The readers were new launches that saw only the pairs «path-free Russian text — translation», not code, documents or expected answers. Their files are in the folder rd70 of the session scratchpad folder named in the launching message: pairs-kk.txt and pairs-en.txt (pass 1, 189 pairs each), answers-kk.txt and answers-en.txt (pass 1 answers), pairs2-kk.txt/pairs2-en.txt and answers2-kk.txt/answers2-en.txt (pass 2: the 15 kk and 25 en pairs corrected after pass 1), pairs3-kk.txt/pairs3-en.txt and answers3.txt (pass 3: six pairs), pairs4-en.txt and answers4.txt (pass 4: pair 153, the owner's one-time extra pass, decisions/0087 item 6), and index.json (number -> tenant and path). The data are tools/src/picker/demo-tenants-v3/stock.json and agency.json.
Do yourself (no trust in reports): (1) Count the pairs: `grep -o '"kk":' tools/src/picker/demo-tenants-v3/stock.json | wc -l` and the same for agency.json (94 and 95), the sum 189 must equal the number of rows of the kk table; the same with '"en":'. (2) Build, for each language, the table «pair number — tenant — path — pass of the LAST reading — answer of that pass (да or нет with the reason)» for all 189 pairs, from the answer files; the final answer of every pair must be «да». (3) The integrity check that matters: for EVERY pair, the text the reader saw at its last reading (from the pairs files of that pass) must equal the text in the data files NOW (kk and en separately; compare byte for byte after reading the JSON; the ru text too). A pair whose text changed after its last «да» is a defect: list it. (4) Count of «нет» per pass and language (expected: pass 1 kk 15, en 25; pass 2 kk 1, en 5; pass 3 kk 0, en 1; pass 4 en 0) and of the corrected texts. (5) Read the 40 corrected pairs yourself as a reader of the language you know best, and say if any correction changed the meaning or the numbers (the numbers in each text must be the same in ru, kk and en; no Cyrillic in en); you are not a native speaker of Kazakh: do not judge the grammar of Kazakh, only meaning and numbers. (6) The unresolved: pairs the readers marked «спорно» but answered «да» (list them for the follow-up list). Result: the table in result (compact), the verdict PASS if all 189 final answers are «да» and no pair changed after its last reading, else FAIL with the list. Write set: your handoff only. No commits, no git checkout/reset/stash/clean. In your handoff text never list project names or machine paths (say "the traces list"). 16 GB RAM computer.

result.summary: Sum-up of the independent readers of REQ-070 (kk and en, 189 pairs each). I counted the pairs myself: stock 94 + agency 95 = 189 for "kk" and for "en", equal to the 189 rows of the reader table (the index maps every number to the same tenant and path as the data, in order). The final reader answer is «да» for all 189 kk pairs and all 189 en pairs. But the verdict is FAIL: the en text of two pairs, 118 («Рекламный бюджет в месяц, ₸?» -> "Monthly ad budget, ₸?") and 119 ("₸ a month"), differs from what the reader saw at its last (only) reading, which was "KZT" in both; the sign was changed to ₸ by decisions/0087 item 5 after pass 1 and these two pairs were never read again. All other 187 pairs in kk and 187 in en equal the text of their last reading, the ru text of all 189 pairs equals what the readers saw, and the kk text of all 189 pairs equals the last reading. Counts of «нет» per pass: kk pass 1 = 15 (of 189), pass 2 = 1 (of 15), pass 3 = 0 (of 1); en pass 1 = 25 (of 189), pass 2 = 5 (of 25), pass 3 = 1 (of 5), pass 4 = 0 (of 1; the owner's one-time pass for pair 153). Last reading: kk pass 1 = 174 pairs, pass 2 = 14, pass 3 = 1 (pair 108); en pass 1 = 164, pass 2 = 20, pass 3 = 4, pass 4 = 1 (pair 153). Corrected texts: 15 kk pairs and 25 en pairs = 40 pairs corrected by the readers' remarks, plus the 2 en pairs with the currency sign (not a reader remark). Pair 108 (kk) needed three versions, pairs 40, 83, 98, 153, 161 (en) two or three. No pair got a third «нет» (the limit of decisions/0087 item 3 was not reached). Marked «спорно» but answered «да»: none (the readers' answer files hold no such mark). My own reading of the 40 corrected pairs plus 118/119 (en read as a reader; kk read only for meaning and numbers, not for grammar): no correction changed the meaning; the numbers are the same in ru, kk and en in all 189 pairs (checked by program: every digit group equal in the three languages, including the "5 questions", 600 000 ₸, 250 000 ₸, 1C, 2GIS), and there is no Cyrillic letter in any en text. Smaller shifts that stay inside the meaning: kk 4 and 98 now name the subject «Сіз» (you) explicitly; kk 107 now says «сіздің көз алдыңызда» (in front of your eyes) and «іске қосу бағасы» (launch price), which the ru text has and the first version had lost; kk 90 is longer but says the same (stocks easily fail to match the shelf); en 28 and 83 lost the word "Handheld" which the ru text does not have; en 33 "A dedicated specialist" now agrees with pair 82; en 188 and 93 "ready-made", "your needs" are fine.
